pipeline.description: Classifies the issue as bug, feature, chore, or spike. Validates required fields (problem statement, acceptance criteria). Rejects malformed issues with a corrective comment.

Drafts a Product Requirements Document for an appropriately-sized issue. Rewrites the issue body with the PRD in user-story + Gherkin format and waits for stakeholder approval at the prd-writer:approved gate. Set-blocks oversized issues with a decomposition note rather than drafting a sprawling PRD.

Scripted step: creates the shared issue branch (issue-{N}) and opens a draft PR with 'Closes #{N}' in the body, establishing the GitHub Development sidebar link. Applies source-issue:{N} label via link-pr-to-issue.sh. All subsequent agent commits (docs, code) accumulate in this PR. Idempotent — exits cleanly if branch and PR already exist. Deterministic; does not invoke Claude CLI.

Cross-checks the approved PRD against existing product documentation in docs/product/. If any docs need updating, writes the changes using its Write tool and emits complete — the orchestrator then stages, commits, and pushes those changes to the shared issue branch (issue-{N}) so they accumulate in the same draft PR as the code. Posts a summary comment. Gates on prd-docs-updater:approved before the build agent starts.

Implements a GitHub issue and its sub-issues as a defensive programmer. Reads the approved PRD, docs/tech-spec/, and each sub-issue in order. Writes code using its Write/Edit tools; the orchestrator stages, commits, and pushes all changes to the shared issue branch (issue-{N}) after the agent signals complete. The draft PR was opened by create-pr and stays draft until pr-reviewer completes.

Ad-hoc PR reviewer. Reads the PR diff and linked issue spec, then posts a structured review covering correctness, design alignment, standards compliance, and security. Concludes with an explicit APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES recommendation. On APPROVE (complete), the orchestrator marks the draft PR ready for merge — the reviewer agent never touches PR state directly. Triggered by pr-reviewer:requested. Gates on pr-reviewer:approved.

Ad-hoc three-persona codebase review (Defensive Programmer, Security Analyst, Quality Assurance). Reads the full codebase and creates a 'Technical Review - {date}' GitHub issue containing all findings with severity ratings and AI-actionable remediation instructions. Triggered by applying the codebase-reviewer:requested label to any issue. Cross-references docs/product/ only when code intent is unclear.
